scripture.verse: "Therefore He says: Awake, you who sleep, Arise from the dead, And Christ will give you light.'"
"Prayer also shall be made for Him continually."

sermons.title: Sermon 718 | The Standard Uplifted In The Face Of The Foe

scripture.verse: "When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the Lord shall lift up a standard against him."

sermons.title: Sermon 719 | Praying In The Holy Spirit

scripture.verse: "And it came to pass on a certain day, as He was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the la w sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them."
"The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death."

sermons.title: Sermon 722 | The Captive Savior Freeing His People

scripture.verse: "Jesus answered, 'I have told you that I am He. If therefore you seek Me, let these go their way,' that the saying might be fulfilled, which He spoke, 'Of them whom You gave Me have I lost none.'"

sermons.title: Sermon 723 | The Root That Bears Wormwood

scripture.verse: "Lest there should be among you a root that bears gall and wormwood."
